prompt:
A photographic portrait of one adult woman against an enormous flat anime-style illustration. Use a portrait frame close to 3:4. The camera looks strongly upward from below her face, showing the underside of her nose and chin. At this close distance, the clothed torso projects much wider than the smaller, more distant head. Her complete crown and face sit high near the center, with a small strip of illustrated backdrop above her hair and her torso filling most of the lower image. The lower crop ends just below the top hem, showing only a narrow midriff strip and a sliver of the lower waistband. Her viewer-right sleeve and upper arm cross the right edge; both hands and the legs are outside the frame. Her chin is lifted and the front of her neck is extended above the chest. Her face turns a little toward viewer-left relative to the chest. The shoulder line rises toward viewer-right. Her eyes look downward toward the low camera. Her head, hair and torso hide the center of the illustration; its giant smiling mouth is visible above and to viewer-left of her head, with broad drawn hair and clothing fragments surviving beside her silhouette. The illustrated head is much larger than her head and is cut off by the top edge; the illustration fills the entire exposed background.

Her oval face narrows through the jaw to a tapered chin, with elongated eyes, pronounced upper eyeliner, a narrow projecting nose and softly parted full lips. Dense blunt bangs cover the forehead while leaving the eyes visible; long straight hair falls along both cheeks and down both sides of the torso to the low crop. The fitted opaque long-sleeve top follows a broad rounded chest contour that narrows toward the lower torso. Its low asymmetric neckline leaves the viewer-right shoulder bare while the sleeve stays around the upper arm. A separate diagonal band crosses the upper chest toward the base of the neck, leaving a triangular opening between the band and the lower neckline.

The nose and cheek planes are more illuminated than the jaw underside and neck. The exposed shoulder forms one broad illuminated plane. The bangs shade the eye area without hiding the eyes. Narrow sheen streaks pick out strands at the hair crown, while the side lengths read as a dark mass. The shirt has a broad shallow shading gradient across the curved upper chest.

Her hair is near-black in value. The hair has very little visible chroma. The top is near-black in value. The top has very little visible chroma. Her exposed skin is light in displayed value. The exposed skin has subdued chroma. The exposed skin midtones are warm beige. The lips have a rose hue. The lip color is muted. The illustrated hair is dusty pink-mauve. The illustrated hair remains muted in chroma. The illustrated clothing is pale. The illustrated clothing is nearly achromatic gray. The lower shirt stays deep in shadow, with only faint fold detail. Highlights on the exposed skin retain tonal modeling without flat white clipping. Keep modest photographic fine-detail softness and softly resolved skin texture, without a glossy wet skin finish; the illustrated backdrop is softer and less detailed than the foreground person.
